messages:
Riley: Heads-up  I'm kicking off a small migration to align snippet naming and glossary terms. Plan: standardize local SDK example variable `result` -> `response`, use `model_version` in code samples, and replace 'cache warming' with 'prefetch' in narrative docs. Will open three tiny PRs (py/js/go).

Ana: Thanks. Can we also shorten captions to single imperatives (e.g., 'Fetch an embedding') and add a one-line parenthetical under snippets: (note: `response` is the client param, not the raw API payload)?

Jon: Linter check: ensure fenced code blocks have language tags (```python, ```js). MDX playground fails on untagged blocks and unescaped backticks. I'll run the markdown linter on branches pre-merge.

Marta: Voice/terminology note: UI copy should read "model version" (two words); code samples use `model_version`. Also prefer active verbs and swap "cache warming" -> "prefetch" everywhere. If a snippet touches an API field name, include a clear PR note that API schema names are unchanged.

docs-bot: Glossary policy v2: preferred term is "prefetch". Automated link-checker: 7 broken links under /docs/samples (report posted to #eng-docs).

Riley: Good catches. PRs will include labels: `docs:migration`, `needs-glossary-review`, `needs-voice-approval` and a short description: "examples-only rename; no API contract modifications." Target review: 5 business days.

Ana: I'll port Python -> JS/Go and include tiny runnable snippets where feasible. Also will add one expandable 'full example' for advanced usage.

Jon: I'll comment on any MDX/CI failures directly in the PRs. Also please avoid renaming API schema fields in examples (we had confusion last week when someone suggested `choices` -> `items`).

Marta: I'll do voice review and flag any ambiguous phrasing. If something seems risky, I'll file a short RFC instead of blocking the PR.

Riley: Opening PRs now and pinging the thread when links to PRs are live. Thanks all. :sparkles:
